svg.aria-label: GPU memory after model upload: separate copies of render vertices V, triangle indices I, original points Q and proxy points R, with copy arrows from the retained CPU buffers. Precise source data and CPU trees are not uploaded.

g.text: GPU memory: model buffer copies after upload

g.text: Four CPU streams are copied. This is buffer payload, not total GPU heap allocation or device-wide VRAM use.

g.text: 37 buffers, with up to 1,048,576 points per buffer. Used when vertex markers are drawn.

g.text: 5 buffers. CPU detail selection chooses ranges of Q or R; the tree stays on the CPU.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #586e77
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #586e77

g.text: Q/R are uploaded even while vertex markers are off. P, S, M, L, T and the annotation cache stay on the CPU.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203139

g.text: Other graphics memory is outside the model-buffer total

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203139

g.text: Colour/depth and MSAA render targets, programs, per-frame parameters, heaps and driver allocations also use graphics memory.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203139

g.text: Upload staging is transient or reusable; reclamation follows GPU completion fences.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203139

g.text: The recorded device-wide VRAM peak includes other applications and is not a per-buffer residency measurement.
